items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I knew him like this, to the public. You never met him. No.

ctx.x: Well, since you run out, do you ever play with the Magnolia Band? No, never did.

I knew of the Magnolia Band. I know Louis Caput was with him, I thought maybe that was the same. You didn't know Caput's brother. Freddie? Yeah. I knew him like this, to the public. You never met him. No. Somebody say that's Freddie Caput. And then I'd see him on different occasions and I'd recognize him, see. But for me to know him, I don't know him, but I knew Louis. Did you hear him play? Did you hear him play? Oh yeah, Freddie, yeah. Oh you did? Oh yeah, I know, I heard him play lots of times. And I thought…
What band did he play with? Oh, let's see if I could call the name of the band, Olympica, believe me.
